ticket.title: N-1: /system/status troubleshooting marks a degraded required service critical and tells operators to restart it

repo.test_runner: vitest (run one file with `npx vitest run <file>` from Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway; setupFiles ./vitest.setup.ts)
repo.typescript: strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, esModuleInterop, module commonjs, target ES2022; the product file's imports at the tip are: import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express'; | import { execSync } from 'child_process'; | import { getRedisHealth } from '../services/redis';

sites.note: (correct) `// Check for unhealthy required services` — leading context of hunk 1. Stays.
**must change** `.filter(s => s.required && s.status !== 'healthy')` — the ONE line you replace: the critical branch must stop taking a degraded service.
(correct) `.forEach(service => {` — trailing context of hunk 1. Stays. (This text also occurs at `:567`; yours is the one at 529.)
(correct) `// Check for unhealthy optional services` — hunk 2 inserts immediately BEFORE this line. Stays.

(correct) `.filter(s => !s.required && s.status !== 'healthy')` — trailing context of hunk 2. Stays: a degraded OPTIONAL service keeps today's optional warning; this ticket is about required services.

expected_plus: // KS-1248: a DEGRADED required service is up and serving with a sick dependency. Restarting it
// can turn a partial outage into a full one, so it gets its own advice: read what it reports
// and fix that dependency. Critical and restart stay reserved for a service that is down.
resolution: service.name + ' is up but reports a failing dependency: read its degradedReasons and fix that dependency. Do not restart it.',
'# Read what the service reports as degraded',
defect_line.sites_rule: every site with must_change=true MUST be changed by the product hunk (its text appears as a '-' line); the checker refuses a diff that leaves one untouched (A3b) before any test runs; sites with key=line+text are matched by LINE NUMBER: the '-' line must be the file's line AT that number (several sites share the same text, so editing one copy does not satisfy another)
red_cells: 🔴 a DEGRADED required service (anchoring answers 200 degraded) gets one warning and no restart command

reference_test_note: READ-ONLY template: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks864a-dead-estate-helper.test.ts` is an EXISTING test in the same __tests__ directory that imports the product module (`routes/system-status`) and drives it in-process with vi.mock stubs for: ../services/redis. Copy its app-building / import / mock shape; do NOT modify it. The ticket's fix shape, quoted: "The exact change — TWO hunks in `services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts`". The ticket-named cell must reach the defective code at line 528 of `services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts` (".filter(s => s.required && s.status !== 'healthy')") and assert the BEHAVIOUR the ticket describes — fix every site the ticket names inside the product file, not only the first.
